items.title: 5.2 Testing aur debugging ki techniques (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu overview of testing and debugging techniques (PDF 64).

blocks.text: Advanced testing aur debugging techniques qabil-e-aitbaar aur kaar-amad applications banane mein madad deti hain. Yeh wazeh ghaltiyan theek karne se aage jati hain: program ke kaam par asar karne wale chhupe masail dhoondti, karkardagi aur user ka itminan barhati, aur aage ki dekh-bhaal asan banati hain.

items: Unit testing: program ke har chhote hisse ko jaanchti hai (topic Unit Testing).
Breakpoints aur watches: program rok kar us ki qeematein dekhte hain (topic Using Breakpoints and Watches).
Exception handling: program ko chalte waqt ki ghaltiyon se bachne deti hai (topic Exception Handling).
Profiling aur optimisation: sust hisse dhoond kar tez karna (topic 5.3).

blocks.prompt: Is chapter ki do techniques batayein jo programs ko zyada qabil-e-aitbaar banati hain, aur har aik kya karti hai.
blocks.explanation: Maslan unit testing jaanchti hai ke har function mutawaqqa output de, aur exception handling runtime ghalti par program ko crash hone se rokti hai. (Breakpoints aur watches, aur profiling bhi durust jawab hain.)

items: Advanced techniques sirf wazeh ghaltiyan nahi, chhupe masail bhi dhoondti hain.
Yeh aitbaar, karkardagi aur dekh-bhaal behtar karti hain.
